meta.class_V4: g-hat(+i/2) = g-hat(-i/2) = g-hat(0) = 0: v_0 = 0, sum h_n v_n = 0, sum n h_n v_n = 0, h_n = 1/(L^2 + 16 pi^2 n^2), L = log(29/10); basis Z in arb balls, ball elimination with every pivot excluding 0
